notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Yo ho ho! Patch 1.1.3 has landed. Full changelog below:

Changelog 1.1.3

+ Fixed issues with the unreliability of the Officer’s electric prod in melee
+ Fixed issues with projectile scaling when player is calibrated to different heights
+ Fixed an issue with airship crate parts not resetting properly
+ Fixed an issue with player possibly getting stuck if pausing the game during fade-ins and -outs
+ Fixed an issue with player’s own arrows rarely colliding with their own bow
+ Fixed an issue which let the player skip parts of level 4, causing them to get stuck
+ Fixed an issue which let the player skip parts of level 6
+ Visual improvements
+ Graphical optimizations
+ Bunch of other fixes

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Ahoy, me hearties, patch 1.1.1 has now landed! This one brings even more graphics optimizations, tutorial screens for the Oculus Rift S controllers and new ways to customize your sprint controls. As customary, the patch also includes a whole bunch of bug fixes and improvements. Full changelog below:

Changelog 1.1.1

+ Graphics optimization
+ Visual improvements
+ Oculus Rift S controller images added to tutorial boards
+ Sprinting has three options now: hold / toggle / always on
+ Less ridiculous bottle physics
+ Fixed an issue in level 3 where enemies weren’t alarmed correctly
+ Fixed several cases where player could force themselves through the architecture
+ Fixed an issue where too tall a player could get stuck in a doorway
+ Fixed several issues concerning the final boss fight
+ Fixed several issues with enemies not getting stunned properly
+ Fixed an issue in level 8 where player’s previous hosts could be left hanging around
+ Fixed an issue allowing the use of certain weapons during pause
+ Fixed level 7 having wrong music intensity on level start
+ Remixed all music tracks and adjusted their volume levels accordingly
+ Other minor fixes

Please [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/86SpcSJ]join our Discord community[/url] for news and discussions about the game!
